other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Transformers (like TF-IDF or TruncatedSVD) or imputation statistics (like median) are fitted on the entire training dataset before the cross-validation loop. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold evaluations overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides a robust and highly engineered solution using a blend of gradient boosting and a tabular neural network. However, it suffers from minor test data peeking by using test set statistics to dictate feature creation, and moderate cross-validation leakage by applying dataset-wide transformations (TF-IDF, SVD, and imputation) before the CV splits.
